method: Apple public search and customer-review RSS via fetch_reviews.py (3 pages, most recent, rated 3 stars or under). Raw review text saved under state/scout/reviews/<app id>.json. Quotes are exact substrings of review text. Reviewer names not recorded. All source_url values are the Apple RSS feed page the review came from. Reviews sampled are recent (mostly Aug to Nov 2026) unless a date shows otherwise.
overlap_note: state/scout/2026-11-17-education.json already holds flashcard-modes-paywalled, paywalled-step-by-step and language-gamification candidates. Candidates here are capability or reliability gaps, not price. Where a candidate touches the same apps (math solvers, Quizlet, Speak, Babbel) the complaints here are about accuracy, scanning, recording and speech checking, not about paywalls. Price-only and paywall-only complaints were left out on purpose. state/scout/rejected.jsonl entries for Education were retried only with broader, capability-based evidence.

excluded_note: data/excluded_categories.yaml was read. Education matches nothing on it, and no candidate matched. Kanji/handwriting, spaced-repetition and Anki-style searches were run; the Anki-style UI-redesign complaints were left out as look and layout complaints rather than capability gaps.
injection_note: No instruction-like text aimed at the reader was found in the reviews read. Some reviews contained mentions of AI tools or profanity or an ad-style appeal; none asked the reader to do anything.
sources_not_used: No WebFetch pages used. No keyword-volume source and no trend source (Google Trends, store ranking history) was consulted, so keyword_data and trend_signals are empty or review-derived throughout. Reddit not used, as instructed. Review sampling is the most recent pages of reviews rated 3 stars or lower, so counts show pattern, not prevalence across all users.
read_depth_note: Saved review files were opened in full or in their first 200 to 240 lines (most recent reviews). Older pages of Photomath, Mathway, Symbolab, Mondly, Babbel, Anki and Quizlet beyond that were not read.
